workloads.name: collections/list-build
workloads.source:
-- Build a List with collecting, then iterate it for a checksum.
on run n
  repeat for each i in 1..n collecting i into values
  end repeat
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each v in values
    add v to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: collections/list-append
workloads.source:
-- Grow a Script Variable while retaining its initial value, then checksum it.
script variable values = []

on run n
  put [-1] into values
  put values into original
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    put i after values
  end repeat
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each v in values
    add v to total
  end repeat
  return total + the length of original
end run

workloads.name: collections/list-update
workloads.source:
-- Update a shared List; the retained original must stay unchanged.
on run n
  put [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] into values
  put values into original
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    put i into item 1 of values
  end repeat
  return item 1 of original + item 1 of values
end run

workloads.name: collections/map-update
workloads.source:
-- Update a shared Map; the retained original must stay unchanged.
on run n
  put {a: 1, b: 2, c: 3, d: 4, e: 5, f: 6, g: 7, h: 8} into values
  put values into original
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    put i into values's a
  end repeat
  return original's a + values's a
end run

workloads.name: collections/iterate
workloads.source:
-- Iterate a 32-item List and a 32-entry Map repeatedly.
on run n
  repeat for each i in 1..32 collecting i into values
  end repeat
  put {} into lookup
  repeat for each i in 1..32
    put i into the (i as text) of lookup
  end repeat
  put 0 into total
  repeat n times
    repeat for each v in values
      add v to total
    end repeat
    repeat for each v in the values of lookup
      add v to total
    end repeat
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: macro/transform
workloads.source:
-- Transform record rows into invoice amounts, then aggregate them.
on run n
  repeat for each i in 1..n collecting {price: i, quantity: 2} into rows
  end repeat
  repeat for each row in rows collecting row's price * row's quantity into amounts
  end repeat
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each amount in amounts
    add amount to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run
